name: @elixir-playground/runtime
description: The playground's runtime: its workers and the usercontent domain's frames (docs/runtime.md). Its published package.json is runtime/build.py's, from src/packages/host.json.

scripts.build: vite build -c vite.runtime.config.ts && vite build -c vite.frames.config.ts && vite build -c vite.runtime.config.ts --mode node
